criteria.why: One golden hour world, few frames pass the showstopper test. Frame 1 best but its bottom 28 percent is empty blotchy caliche and the risers are tokens. Frame 2 leaves the lower 45 percent flat, the person has no contact shadow, the nearest enclosure is cropped dark, a silencer sits behind the dek. Frame 4's back rows render solid black faces, a wide empty caliche band, REGION 2 nearly runs into the peak label. Frame 5 spends 65 percent on a flat unweathered olive door plate, the page reads as a sticker, the hook's The straddles the door to sky seam.
